比耄耋更久一些。: A little longer than a ripe old age.
下一个世纪的第一天，你还在。: On the first day of the next century, you were still here.
比出生时的预期寿命多活 10 年以上。: Outlive your life expectancy at birth by 10 years or more.
比同年同国出生的 99% 的人都长寿。: Outlive 99% of people born in the same year and country.
和你同年出生的人，几乎都比你先走。: Nearly everyone born the year you were went before you.
80 岁以后离世，健康仍在 60 以上。: Die after 80 with health still above 60.
这一生没能走到 18 岁。短暂的人生，也被认真记住。: This life did not reach 18. A short life is still remembered with care.
父母都没读过大学，家境也普通，你读完了大学。: With neither parent at university and an ordinary family income, you finished university.
在一场关键考试里考得非常好。: Do very well in a crucial exam.
中国学生最熟悉的那场考试。: The exam every Chinese student knows.
一场关键考试没考好。人生还长。: Do badly in a crucial exam. Life is long.
没读大学，知识却在 97 以上。: Skip university, yet reach knowledge above 97.
自己开过店、创过业。: Run a shop or start a business.
工作被自动化取代过。: Have your job replaced by automation.
在中国报考过公务员。: Sit the civil service exam in China.
千军万马里，你过了那座独木桥。: Among the massed thousands, you crossed that narrow bridge.
在互联网大厂式的加班节奏里熬过。: Survive the overtime of a big tech company.
认真想过要不要躺平。: Seriously consider lying flat and opting out.
身家达到 100 万（按 2021 年国际购买力计）。: Reach a net worth of 1M (international purchasing power, 2021).
比百万富翁再多一个零。: One more zero than a millionaire.
出身比全国 80% 的家庭都穷，最后身家超过 50 万。: Born poorer than 80% of families in the country, end with over 500K.
起点很低，终点很高。: A low start, a high finish.
买下了自己的房子。: Buy a home of your own.
离世时仍然资不抵债。: Die owing more than you own.
和同一个人走过 50 年婚姻。: Spend 50 years married to the same person.
和同一个人走过 60 年婚姻。: Spend 60 years married to the same person.
有儿子也有女儿。: Have both a son and a daughter.
没有结婚、没有孩子，离世时依然快乐（70 以上）。: No marriage, no children, and still happy (above 70) at the end.
谈婚论嫁时，为彩礼发过愁。: Worry about the bride price when planning a marriage.
和旧人重新联系上。: Get back in touch with someone from the past.
养过猫，也养过狗。: Keep a cat and also a dog.
小时候父母外出打工，你留在老家。: Your parents left to find work when you were small, and you stayed in the home village.
出生在 2027 年以后，一出生就在推演的世界线里（出生登记里可以选出生年代）。: Be born after 2027, on a projected world line from your first breath (you can pick the birth era at birth registration).
在出生地以外的国家走完一生。: End your life in a country other than the one you were born in.
离开过家乡，又回来了。: Leave your home and come back.
因为战乱或灾害离开过家园。: Leave home because of war or disaster.
经历过疫情期间居家的日子。: Live through the pandemic's days at home.
接受过延缓衰老的新疗法。: Receive a new treatment to slow ageing.
在虚拟现实里开过会。: Attend a meeting in virtual reality.
第一次坐飞机。: Fly in a plane for the first time.
某一年里，健康、快乐、知识、人际、财富全都在 85 以上。: In a single year, have health, happiness, knowledge, relationships and wealth all above 85.
某一年，五项都很好。: One year when all five were good.
晚年写下了自己的回忆录。: Write your memoirs late in life.
在抉择里 3 次写下自己的选择。: Write your own choice 3 times at decisions.
在人生路上写下 3 段想法。: Write down 3 thoughts during a life.
给走完的这一生留下一句话。: Leave a line for a life that has ended.
亲自为 20 年的生活选定重心。: Set your own focus for 20 years of life.
现实中极少发生的际遇。: An encounter that rarely happens in reality.
男女都活过一次。: Live once as a man and once as a woman.
世界上每个角落，都有过你的一生。: Every corner of the world has held a life of yours.
